items.stem: There is some ______ on the table, and you can have a piece of it.
items.analysis: bread 是不可数名词，没有复数形式，也不能与 a/an 连用；some 既可以修饰可数名词复数，也可以修饰不可数名词。A、C、D 都把不可数名词当作可数名词处理，是最常见的错因。

items.stem: My sister bought two ______ of shoes in the shop yesterday.
items.analysis: pair 是量词，本身可数，two 后要用复数 pairs，构成 two pairs of shoes。A 用单数与 two 不一致；C 是名词所有格，后面不能再接 of 短语；D 改变了量词的含义。

items.stem: My uncle has bought two ___ for his new flat.
items.analysis: shelf 以 -f 结尾，变复数时改 -f 为 -v 再加 -es，即 shelves；其余三项均为错误拼写。

items.stem: Look! The ______ are playing football in the playground.
items.analysis: child 的复数是不规则形式 children，谓语 are 也提示主语为复数。A 单数与 are 不一致；B、D 是学生常写的错误形式 childs 和 childrens。

items.stem: Could you give me some ___ about how to prepare for the exam?
items.analysis: advice 是不可数名词，没有复数形式，也不能用 a/an 修饰；advise 是对应的动词。

items.stem: In autumn, there are many fallen ______ (leaf) on the ground.
items.analysis: leaf 以 f 结尾，复数把 f 变 v 再加 es，即 leaves，同类还有 half→halves、wolf→wolves。many 提示此处必须用复数。

items.stem: There are five woman doctors in the room.
items.analysis: 复合名词中 man/woman 作定语修饰另一名词时，两部分都要变复数：five women doctors。原句只变了中心词 doctors，是常见错误。

items.stem: ______ room is on the third floor, and it is big and bright.
items.analysis: 两人共同拥有同一间房时，只在最后一个名词后加 's，即 Lucy and Lily's room。B 表示两人各自拥有房间，与后面的单数 room 及代词 it 矛盾；A、D 缺少所有格标记。

items.stem: We need three ______ to write down all the numbers.
items.analysis: paper 作「纸」讲是不可数名词，计量时用 piece of paper，变复数只变 piece，即 three pieces of paper。C、D 把不可数名词 paper 也加了复数，是典型错误。

items.stem: He gave me a lot of ______ on how to improve my spoken English.
items.analysis: advice 是不可数名词，不能加 s，也不能与 an 连用，故用 a lot of advice。C 多了冠词，A 误加复数，D 的 advise 是动词，词性不符。

items.stem: The ______ of the two companies met in Chengdu last week.
items.analysis: 两家公司各有经理，指多人，用复数 managers 作主语。C、D 是所有格形式，后面缺少被修饰的名词；B 单数与「两家公司」的语境不符。

items.stem: It is about ______ walk from my home to the school, so I often go there on foot.
items.analysis: 表示时间、距离的所属关系用名词所有格：ten minutes' walk。minutes 是以 s 结尾的复数名词，只加撇号；A 单数与 ten 矛盾，C 用连字符构成形容词不能作 walk 的定语中心，D 没有任何所有格标记。

items.stem: Two ______ (knife) are enough to cut the birthday cake.
items.analysis: knife 以 fe 结尾，复数把 fe 变成 v 再加 es，即 knives。two 提示用复数，注意不要写成 knifes。

items.stem: Please give me some ______ (information) about the trains to Chongqing.
items.analysis: information 是不可数名词，没有复数形式，some 后直接跟原形。学生常误加 s 写成 informations。

items.stem: He is a friend of my father.
items.analysis: 表示「我父亲的一个朋友」应用双重所有格 a friend of my father's。of 后接名词性物主代词或名词所有格才能表示「其中之一」，原句少了 's。

items.stem: 把下面的句子译成英语：我们学校图书馆里有三千多本书。
items.answer: There are more than three thousand books in our school library.
items.analysis: there be 句型表示「有」，主语 books 为复数，用 There are；thousand 前有具体数字时不加 s，也不加 of；「三千多」用 more than three thousand。

items.stem: 把下面的句子译成英语：从这里到医院大约有十分钟的步行路程。
items.answer: It is about ten minutes' walk from here to the hospital.
items.analysis: 英语常用 It is + 距离 + 名词所有格 walk 表示「步行……的路程」；ten minutes 为复数，所有格只加撇号；from here to the hospital 作地点状语。

items.stem: ___ bike was stolen last night, so he had to take a bus to work.
items.analysis: bike 是单数，说明两人共用一辆车，只在最后一个名词后加 's；若各自拥有则用 Tom's and Jim's，且后接复数名词。

items.stem: Choose all the correctly spelled plural forms.
items.analysis: 以 -o 结尾的 potato、tomato、hero 变复数加 -es，photo 是 photograph 的缩略词，只加 -s；leaf 变复数改 -f 为 -v 加 -es，即 leaves。

items.stem: There are two ___ in our department, and both of them are very kind.
items.analysis: man、woman 作定语修饰名词时，若被修饰的名词变复数，man、woman 也要随之变复数，故为 women doctors。

items.stem: After the heavy snow, the ______ of the old houses were all covered with white.
items.analysis: roof 的复数直接加 s，即 roofs，属规则变化。B 的 rooves 是学生按 thief→thieves 类推出来的错误形式；A 单数与 were 不一致；D 拼写不存在。

items.stem: My mother wants to buy ______ for my grandmother's birthday.
items.analysis: jewellery 是不可数名词，不能直接与 a 连用，也不能变复数，计量用 a piece of jewellery。B、C、D 都把它当作可数名词，是本题主要错因。

items.stem: Our teacher often tells us that ______ is the key to success.
items.analysis: work 表示「工作、劳动」时不可数，hard work 泛指艰苦的劳动，前面不加冠词。B、C、D 均把 work 当可数名词处理。

items.stem: Nobody knows the exact ______ of the mountain in that area.
items.analysis: the exact ______ of the mountain 需要名词作宾语中心词，height 是 high 的名词形式。A、C 是形容词和副词，不能作主语；D 用复数与 the exact 搭配不当。

items.stem: The two ______ (editor-in-chief) are discussing the new plan.
items.analysis: 以 man/woman 结尾的复合名词变复数时，把中心词变为复数。editor-in-chief 的中心词是 editor，故为 editors-in-chief，chief 不变。

items.stem: Ten years ___ passed since we last met, but his ___ of humour has not changed at all.
items.analysis: ten years 表示一段时间，视为整体，谓语用单数 has；sense of humour 中 sense 表抽象概念，为不可数名词，用单数。

items.stem: Fill in the blanks with the correct form of the words in brackets: (1) Several ___ (passer-by) stopped to help the old man. (2) A ___ (woman) doctor gave him first aid at once.
items.analysis: 复合名词 passer-by 变复数时在中心词 passer 后加 -s，即 passers-by；woman 作定语修饰单数 doctor，保持单数形式。

items.stem: My father is ______ honest man, and he never tells lies.
items.analysis: honest 的 h 不发音，读音以元音音素 /ɒ/ 开头，故用 an。判断用 a 还是 an 要看读音而不是首字母，hour、honour 同理。

items.stem: We usually have ______ breakfast at seven in the morning.
items.analysis: 表示一日三餐的名词前一般用零冠词：have breakfast/lunch/supper。若三餐前有形容词修饰（如 a quick breakfast），才可以用 a。

items.stem: My father is ___ honest man, and he works as ___ engineer in a big company.
items.analysis: honest 首音为元音音素，用 an；engineer 同样以元音音素开头，也用 an。冠词的选择取决于读音而非首字母。

items.stem: This is ______ useful book for beginners of English.
items.analysis: useful 虽以元音字母 u 开头，但读音是 /ˈjuːsfl/，以辅音音素 /j/ 开头，故用 a。university、usual、European 同理；而 umbrella、uncle 前用 an。

items.stem: ___ Great Wall is one of the most famous places of interest in China.
items.analysis: 由普通名词构成的专有名词（the Great Wall、the United States）前须加定冠词 the。

items.stem: I bought ______ new pen yesterday, and ______ pen writes very well.
items.analysis: 第一空首次提到「一支新钢笔」，用不定冠词 a；第二空再次提到同一支笔，是特指，用 the。这是冠词最基本的「首次提及用 a、再次提及用 the」规则。

items.stem: He is an university student and studies computer science.
items.analysis: university 读 /ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːsɪti/，以辅音音素 /j/ 开头，应用 a 而不是 an。判断冠词看读音，不看首字母。

items.stem: ______ sun rises in the east and sets in the west.
items.analysis: sun 是世界上独一无二的事物，前面用定冠词 the，同类还有 the moon、the earth、the sky。A、B 把独一无二的事物当作泛指，D 缺少冠词。

items.stem: My uncle works in ______ university in Beijing, and he teaches ______ history there.
items.analysis: university 读 /ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːsɪti/，以辅音音素 /j/ 开头，用 a；history 是学科名，泛指时用零冠词。B、D 在 university 前误用 an，C 在学科名前多了 the。

items.stem: She is ______ tallest girl in our class.
items.analysis: 形容词最高级前要加 the：the tallest girl。只有副词最高级或表语位置的最高级前 the 才可以省略。

items.stem: We go to school by ______ bike every day, but today I came ______ foot.
items.analysis: by bike（骑自行车）与 on foot（步行）都是固定搭配，名词前不加冠词。A、C 在 by 后多加了冠词，D 把 on foot 误作 by foot。

items.stem: He plays ______ piano very well, but he doesn't like ______ music of that film.
items.analysis: play 后接乐器名词要加 the（play the piano），球类名词前则不加；第二空特指「那部电影的音乐」，用 the。B、D 第二空漏掉 the，C 第一空漏掉 the。

items.stem: ______ Great Wall is one of ______ most famous places of interest in China.
items.analysis: the Great Wall 是专有名词，固定加 the；one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词结构中，最高级前也要 the。

items.stem: He went to ______ bed early last night because he had ______ cold.
items.analysis: go to bed 是固定搭配，bed 前用零冠词；have a cold（感冒）是固定搭配，cold 前用 a。两处都不能随意加 the。

items.stem: The history is my favourite subject at school.
items.analysis: 学科名称 history 泛指时用零冠词，不加 the。the history 会被理解为特指某段历史，与「最喜欢的科目」这一语境不符。

items.stem: 把下面的句子译成英语：她每天早上七点吃早饭。
items.answer: She has breakfast at seven every morning.
items.analysis: 「吃早饭」是 have breakfast，三餐名词前用零冠词，不能译成 have a breakfast；时间状语 at seven every morning 放句末。

items.stem: 把下面的句子译成英语：他是我们班上唯一一个去过北京的学生。
items.answer: He is the only student in our class who has been to Beijing.
items.analysis: 「唯一一个……的学生」用 the only student；先行词被 only 修饰时定语从句常用 who/that；「去过北京」表示经历，用现在完成时 have been to。

items.stem: He plays ___ piano very well, but he doesn't like playing ___ football.
items.analysis: play 后接乐器名词须加 the，接球类运动名词则不加冠词，即 play the piano、play football。

items.stem: In the sentence 'He was sent to hospital after the accident', no article is needed before 'hospital' because the phrase refers to receiving medical treatment.
items.analysis: be sent to hospital 表示'住院就医'这一抽象活动，hospital 前不用冠词；若特指某一家医院则须用 the。

items.stem: What ___ fun it is to swim in the sea in summer!
items.analysis: fun 是不可数名词，感叹句中 what 后不接 a/an，故此处不加冠词。

items.stem: I have ______ headache, so I want to see ______ doctor this afternoon.
items.analysis: have a headache 是固定搭配，头痛前用 a；see a doctor 表示「看医生」，泛指用 a。C 把 headache 前的 a 换成 the，属多余的特别指称。

items.stem: He was elected ______ chairman of the Students' Union last term.
items.analysis: chairman 在此作主语补足语，表示独一无二的职位，前面用零冠词，类似还有 be elected president/monitor。A、C 与「唯一职位」的语义不符。

items.stem: ______ Mr. Smith is waiting for you at the school gate.
items.analysis: Mr. Smith 是人名，专有名词前一般不用冠词。A、B 把姓名当作可数名词；C 的 the 用于特指一家人或姓氏复数，此处不合语境。

items.stem: He is ______ only person who knows the truth, so you'd better ask him.
items.analysis: only 修饰的名词前用 the 表示「唯一的那一个」：the only person。A、B 用不定冠词与 only 的语义矛盾，D 缺少冠词。

items.stem: ______ second paragraph of the passage is mainly about ______ environment.
items.analysis: 序数词 second 前用 the 表示「第二段」；the environment 是特指我们身处其中的环境，为常见固定说法，故第二空也用 the。

items.stem: Of all the subjects, he likes ___ history best, but his sister prefers ___ history of ancient China.
items.analysis: 学科名称前一般不加冠词；the history of ancient China 因有 of 短语限定而表示特指，须用 the。

items.stem: Fill in each blank with a, an, the or / (zero article): (1) It took us half ___ hour to get there. (2) ___ more careful you are, the fewer mistakes you will make. (3) My uncle is ___ honest businessman.
items.analysis: hour 首音为元音音素，用 an；'the + 比较级, the + 比较级' 是固定结构；honest 以元音音素开头，用 an。

items.stem: Tom and I are good friends, and ______ often help each other.
items.analysis: 空格在句中作主语，指 Tom and I，要用主格 we。B 是宾格，C 是形容词性物主代词，D 是名词性物主代词，都不能作主语。

items.stem: This is not my umbrella. ___ is the blue one over there.
items.analysis: 此处作主语，须用名词性物主代词 mine，相当于 my umbrella。

items.stem: Help ___ to some fish, children.
items.analysis: help oneself to 意为'随便吃'；呼语 children 是复数，反身代词须用 yourselves。

items.stem: This book is ______ (I), and that one is ______ (she).
items.analysis: 两空后都没有名词，要用名词性物主代词：mine（= my book）、hers（= her book）。形容词性物主代词 my/her 不能单独使用。

items.stem: My bike is broken. Can you lend me your?
items.analysis: lend me your 后面缺少名词，要用名词性物主代词 yours（= your bike）。形容词性物主代词 your 不能单独使用。

items.stem: This is a secret between you and ______, so don't tell anyone else.
items.analysis: between 是介词，其后的人称代词作宾语，须用宾格 me。I 是主格，不能作介词宾语；mine 是名词性物主代词，不能指人作宾语；myself 是反身代词，此处说话人并非“自己对自己”，不合语境。

items.stem: The little girl is old enough to dress ______ now.
items.analysis: dress oneself 表示「给自己穿衣服」，主语 the little girl 是单数女性，用 herself。A 是宾格，dress her 意为「给她穿衣」，与主语自身不符。

items.stem: ______ of the two answers is correct, so you have to try again.
items.analysis: 指两者（the two answers）全部否定用 neither，谓语用单数 is，与后面的「必须再试」一致。A 的 both 表肯定且谓语要用 are；C、D 用于三者及以上。

items.stem: Some students like pop music, while ______ prefer classical music.
items.analysis: some...others 表示「一些……另一些（泛指）」。A 的 other 后必须接名词；C 的 the other 指两者中的另一个；D 的 another 只指单数。

items.stem: Don't worry. There is ______ wrong with the computer. It works well.
items.analysis: 后句 It works well 说明电脑没有毛病，用 nothing wrong。B 的 anything 多用于否定句和疑问句；A、D 与「运转正常」的语境矛盾。

items.stem: The children enjoyed ______ (they) at the party last night.
items.analysis: enjoy oneself 是固定搭配，意为「玩得开心」；主语 the children 是复数，反身代词用 themselves。

items.stem: ______ (who) dictionary is this? — It's Tom's.
items.analysis: 问「这是谁的字典」，空格后接名词 dictionary，要用疑问代词所有格 Whose。Who's 是 Who is 的缩写，不能修饰名词。

items.stem: Every of the students in our class has passed the exam.
items.analysis: every 是形容词，不能直接接 of 短语；表示「每一个」+ of + 复数名词要用 each，即 Each of the students。

items.stem: 把下面的句子译成英语：我们班每个人都喜欢英语，因为英语很有趣。
items.answer: Everyone in our class likes English because it is interesting.
items.analysis: 「每个人」用不定代词 everyone 作主语，谓语用单数 likes；原因状语从句用 because 引导，代词 it 指代 English，避免重复。

items.stem: 把下面的句子译成英语：我认为和他交朋友很容易。
items.answer: I find it easy to make friends with him.
items.analysis: 「认为……很容易」用 find it + 形容词 + to do 结构，it 是形式宾语，真正宾语是 to make friends with him。

items.stem: — How many of the three plans do you think will work? — ______, I'm afraid. They are all too expensive.
items.analysis: 问句问的是三者（three plans）中有几个可行，指三者及以上的“一个也没有”用 none；neither 只用于两者；no one 只能指人；nothing 指物但不与 how many 的计数回答搭配。

items.stem: I have two brothers. One is a doctor, and ___ is a teacher.
items.analysis: 两者中的另一个用 the other；another 指不定数目中的另一个，others 泛指其余一些。

items.stem: The project is far from finished. We need ______ two weeks to complete it.
items.analysis: another + 数词 + 复数名词是固定用法，表示“再、又（多长时间/多少个）”。other 后接复数名词时前面须有 the、some 等限定词；the other 指两者中剩下的那一个；others 是代词，后面不能再接 two weeks。

items.stem: Choose all the sentences in which the pronouns are used correctly.
options: Everyone of the students has a dictionary.
Each of the students has a dictionary.
All of the students have dictionaries.
Every of the students has a dictionary.
items.analysis: each of + 复数名词作主语谓语用单数，all of + 复数名词谓语用复数，both ... are 也正确；everyone、every 不能直接接 of 短语，故 A、D 错。

items.stem: I find ___ hard to get along with him.
items.analysis: find it + 形容词 + to do sth 中用 it 作形式宾语，真正的宾语是后面的不定式。

items.stem: ______ of the students in our class has a dictionary of English.
items.analysis: each of + 复数名词作主语时谓语用单数，与 has 一致。B 的 every 是形容词，不能直接接 of 短语；C、D 作主语时谓语要用复数 have。

items.stem: I found ______ hard to get along with him at first.
items.analysis: find it + 形容词 + to do 结构中 it 是形式宾语，真正宾语是后面的不定式。B、C 不能作形式宾语；D 的 one 表泛指，不能替代不定式短语。

items.stem: The weather in Chengdu is much warmer than ______ in Harbin in winter.
items.analysis: 比较的对象是「天气」，用 that 替代前面提到的不可数名词 the weather，避免重复。A 的 it 指同一事物；C 的 this 指近处；D 的 one 替代可数名词单数。

items.stem: — Who is knocking at the door? — ______ must be the postman.
items.analysis: 不知道敲门者是谁、性别不明时，用 it 指人。A、B 预设了性别；D 的 they 与 must be 连用指复数，与 the postman 不符。

items.stem: Between you and ______ (I), I don't think the plan will work.
items.analysis: 介词后要用宾格，between you and me 是固定说法。学生常按「作主语用 I」误写成 between you and I。

items.stem: It was in the park ___ I met an old friend of ___.
items.analysis: 本句是 It was ... that 强调句型，被强调的是地点状语 in the park，连接词仍用 that；an old friend of mine 是双重所有格。

items.stem: Fill in the blanks with the proper form of the pronoun in brackets: (1) The book is not ___ (I); it belongs to ___ (she). (2) They enjoyed ___ (them) at the party last night.
items.analysis: 作表语用名词性物主代词 mine；介词 to 后接宾格 her；enjoy oneself 是固定搭配，主语 they 用 themselves。

items.stem: This bag is much ______ than that one.
items.analysis: than 提示比较级，cheap 是单音节词，比较级加 er；much 修饰比较级加强语气。A 是原级，C、D 是最高级，都不能与 than 连用。

items.stem: This is ______ film I have ever seen.
items.analysis: I have ever seen 限定了比较范围，三者以上比较用形容词最高级并加 the：the best film。A、B 与原级、比较级不符；D 漏掉 the。

items.stem: This book is much ___ than that one.
items.analysis: 多音节形容词的比较级用 more + 原级，than 提示此处为比较级；interested 用于修饰人的感受。

items.stem: The English lesson is very ______, and we are all ______ in it.
items.analysis: -ing 形容词表示「令人……的」，修饰事物 lesson；-ed 形容词表示「感到……的」，修饰人 we。B 正好颠倒，是本题最常见的错因。

items.stem: The film was so ___ that all of us felt ___.
items.analysis: -ing 形容词修饰事物，意为'令人……的'；-ed 形容词修饰人的感受，故为 boring film、feel bored。

items.stem: This is the ______ (good) way to learn new words.
items.analysis: 三者以上比较用最高级，good 的最高级是不规则形式 best，前面加 the。

items.stem: He runs very fastly and always wins the race.
items.analysis: fast 的副词形式与形容词同形，英语中没有 fastly 这个词。hard/hardly、late/lately 才是形副不同形的易混词。

items.stem: My handwriting is ______ than yours.
items.analysis: than 提示比较级，good 的比较级是不规则形式 better。B 的 well 是副词，不能作表语；D 是最高级。

items.stem: This box is ______ heavier than that one, so I can't carry it.
items.analysis: 修饰比较级 heavier 要用 much、far、a lot 等程度副词，不能用 very、too。D 的 more 与比较级 -er 重复，构成双重比较级。

items.stem: He speaks English much ______ now than he did last year.
items.analysis: 修饰动词 speaks 要用副词，than 又提示比较级，故用 more fluently。A、C 是形容词；B 是原级，与 than 冲突。

items.stem: ______ we study, ______ we will learn.
items.analysis: 「the + 比较级，the + 比较级」表示「越……越……」，是固定句式，两个分句都要有 the。A、B 缺少 the 且未用比较级；D 用的是最高级。

items.stem: Her voice sounds ______, and everyone likes listening to her songs.
items.analysis: sound 是系动词，后接形容词作表语，用 sweet。A、B、D 都是副词，不能作系动词的表语。

items.stem: The soup tastes ______ (delicious) than it looks.
items.analysis: than 提示比较级；delicious 是多音节词，比较级用 more delicious，不能写成 deliciouser。

items.stem: He looked at me ______ (angry) and said nothing.
items.analysis: 修饰动词短语 looked at 要用副词，angry 的副词形式是 angrily。学生常直接填 angry，属词性误用。

items.stem: This book is more interesting than any book in the library.
items.analysis: 主语 this book 本身也在 the library 的范围内，比较级要用 any other + 单数名词排除自身，否则出现「比包括自己在内的所有书都有趣」的逻辑错误。

items.stem: 把下面的句子译成英语：他比我高两厘米。
items.answer: He is two centimetres taller than me.
items.analysis: 比较级前可加数量状语 two centimetres 表示相差的幅度；than 后接比较对象，口语中用宾格 me，正式文体可用 I。

items.stem: 把下面的句子译成英语：这是我看过的最有趣的电影。
items.answer: This is the most interesting film I have ever seen.
items.analysis: 「我看过的最有趣的」用最高级 the most interesting + 定语从句 I have ever seen，从句用现在完成时表示到目前为止的经历。

items.stem: Tom is ___ of the two boys, but he is less careful than his brother.
items.analysis: of the two 表示两者之间的比较，用比较级并加 the，表示'两者中较……的那一个'。

items.stem: Choose all the sentences in which the comparative or superlative form is used correctly.
options: He runs much faster than I do.
This is the easiest question of the three.
She is more careful than any other girl in her class.
He is more taller than his brother.
The more you read, the more you know.
items.analysis: 比较级前不能再加 more 修饰 taller，故 D 错；其余各句的比较级、最高级及 the more ... the more 结构均正确。

items.stem: The task turned out to be ___ difficult than we had expected.
items.analysis: 修饰比较级用 much、far、even、a little 等；very 和 too 不能修饰比较级。

items.stem: He is ______ than any other student in his class.
items.analysis: than any other student 已把自身排除在比较范围外，用比较级 taller。C、D 是最高级，与 than 冲突；A 是原级。

items.stem: The population of China is much larger than ______ of Japan.
items.analysis: 比较对象是 population，用 that 替代前面出现的单数名词，避免重复。B、C 指代不明；D 的 one 替代可数名词单数，而 population 在此按不可数/单数整体看待更宜用 that。

items.stem: The teacher asked us to keep the windows ______ and the door ______.
items.analysis: keep + 宾语 + 形容词作宾补，表示「使……保持某种状态」。open 作形容词表状态，closed 已形容词化表「关着的」；opened 强调动作，close 是动词，均不能作宾补。

items.stem: He is ______ of the two brothers, though he is younger.
items.analysis: 「两者中较……的一个」用 the + 比较级 + of the two，故为 the taller。B 缺少 the，C、D 是最高级，用于三者及以上。

items.stem: The more careful you are, the ______ (few) mistakes you will make.
items.analysis: 「the + 比较级，the + 比较级」结构，few 的比较级是 fewer，修饰可数名词复数 mistakes。

items.stem: The ___ look on her face suggested that she was ___ with the result.
items.analysis: look 指人的神色，用 disappointed；be dissatisfied with 意为'对……不满意'，dissatisfying 意为'令人不满的'。

items.stem: Complete the sentences with the proper form of the words in brackets: (1) The news was so ___ (excite) that the children jumped with joy. (2) Of all the students, he works ___ (hard). (3) The problem is far more ___ (complicate) than we thought.
items.analysis: news 令人激动，用 -ing 形式；of all 表示范围比较，用最高级 hardest；complicated 在此作表语。

items.stem: Mr. Wang has been teaching in this village school ______ 2015.
items.analysis: since 后接时间点（2015），表示动作从那时开始并延续到现在，与 has been teaching 的现在完成进行时搭配；for 后须接时间段（如 for ten years）；in 和 during 都不能表示「自从」这一持续起点。常见错因是把 since 与 for 的搭配对象颠倒。

items.stem: The meeting will begin ___ nine o'clock ___ the morning of May 1st.
items.analysis: 具体时刻前用 at；带具体日期的早上、下午用 on，即 on the morning of May 1st。

items.stem: ______ my surprise, the little boy worked out the problem in only two minutes.
items.analysis: to one's surprise 是固定短语，意为「令某人惊讶的是」；同类还有 to one's joy、to one's disappointment。in、at、for 均不能构成该搭配，学生常受 in surprise（惊讶地，作状语）干扰而误选 In。

items.stem: Mo Yan is famous ______ his novels, and many of them have been translated into foreign languages.
items.analysis: be famous for 表示「以……（作品、特征）而闻名」；be famous as 后接身份（如 as a writer）。本句宾语是 his novels（作品），故用 for；with 和 by 不与 famous 搭配。

items.stem: He has been learning English ___ five years.
items.analysis: for 接一段时间，since 接时间点，二者均与完成时连用；此处 five years 是一段时间。

items.stem: The little girl is afraid ______ dogs, so she never goes near them. (每空一词)
items.analysis: be afraid of sth 是固定搭配，表示「害怕某物」；afraid to do sth 表示「不敢做某事」，后面应接动词，与本题的名词 dogs 不符。

items.stem: ______ my opinion, students should be given more time to read after class.
items.analysis: in one's opinion 是固定介词短语，意为“依某人看”。on、at、to 都不与 opinion 构成这一含义的搭配；to my mind 虽也表“我认为”，但中心词是 mind 而非 opinion。

items.stem: Sichuan lies ______ the southwest of China and is famous for its spicy food.
items.analysis: 表示在某范围之内用 in the southwest of China（四川是中国的一部分）；to the southwest of China 指境外、位于中国西南方向，与常识矛盾；on 表示接壤的外部方位；at 不用于方位表达。

items.stem: Look both ways before you walk ______ the street.
items.analysis: across 指在表面横穿（过街、过河）；through 指从内部穿过（森林、隧道）；over 强调从上方越过；above 只表示位置高于。过马路是平面横穿，只能用 across。

items.stem: You can improve your spoken English ______ practising with your classmates every day.
items.analysis: by + 动名词表示「通过某种方式、手段」，是方式状语的固定表达；with 后接工具或伴随对象，不能直接跟 doing 表手段；for 和 of 没有这种用法。

items.stem: The school has taken many measures to prevent students ______ playing near the river.
items.analysis: prevent sb from doing sth（= stop sb from doing sth）是固定搭配，from 可以省略但不能换成其他介词。学生常受 keep sb away from 影响而误选 away，但 away 不能直接接 doing。

items.stem: She spent thirty yuan ______ the new dictionary yesterday.
items.analysis: spend money on sth 是固定搭配；只有 spend time (in) doing sth 才用 in + 动名词。for 用于 pay money for sth、buy sth for money 的结构，本句动词是 spend，不能选 for。

items.stem: He is good ______ English and does well ______ all his subjects. (每空一词)
items.analysis: be good at 表示「擅长（技能、学科）」，do well in 表示「在某方面表现好」，两处都是固定搭配。注意 good at 不能写成 good in，do well in 也不能写成 do well at。

items.stem: ______ average, each student in our class spends two hours ______ homework every day. (每空一词)
items.analysis: on average 意为「平均而言」，位于句首时首字母大写；spend time on sth 是固定搭配。第二空易误填 in，但 in 只用于 spend time (in) doing sth 的结构。

items.stem: 判断下列句子是否正确：He has lived in Chengdu since three years. (√ / ×)
items.analysis: since 后接时间点（since 2020、since last year），three years 是时间段，须改为 for three years。since 与 for 的用法互换是完成时最典型的错因。

items.stem: 将下列句子译成英语：他每天骑自行车上学。
items.answer: He goes to school by bike every day.
items.analysis: by + 交通工具（中间不加冠词）表示交通方式，是介词短语作方式状语的典型用法；every day 表习惯，用一般现在时，主语为第三人称单数，动词加 -es。学生常误写 by a bike 或 on bike。

items.stem: 将下列句子译成英语：在老师的帮助下，我的英语取得了很大进步。
items.answer: With the help of my teacher, I have made great progress in English.
items.analysis: with the help of 表示「在……的帮助下」，with 不能换成 under；make progress in 是固定搭配，progress 为不可数名词，不加 a 也不加 -s；「取得了进步」用现在完成时 have made 更贴切。

items.stem: ___ the help of my teacher, I have made great progress.
items.analysis: with the help of 是固定短语，意为'在……的帮助下'。

items.stem: In the phrase 'within a week', 'within' means 'after the end of a week'.
items.analysis: within 表示'在……之内、不超过'，相当于 before the end of a week；'在……之后' 才用 after。

items.stem: The flight was put off ___ the heavy fog.
items.analysis: because of 是介词短语，后接名词；because、although 是连词，须引导从句。

items.stem: ______ entering the room, he found that nobody was there.
items.analysis: on + 动名词表示「一……就……」，相当于 as soon as，强调两个动作紧接发生；in doing 表示「在……过程中」；at 后不接动名词表此义；by doing 表示方式手段。

items.stem: Our manager is very strict ______ his staff ______ their work.
items.analysis: be strict with sb 表示「对某人严格」，be strict in sth 表示「对某事要求严格」，两个介词分工固定。学生常两空都填 with，或把 with 误写成 to（受 be kind to 干扰）。

items.stem: The girl was so absorbed ______ her book that she didn't hear the bell ring.
items.analysis: be absorbed in 意为「全神贯注于」，是固定搭配，同类还有 be interested in、be lost in。on、with、at 都不能与 absorbed 搭配。

items.stem: ______ spite of the heavy rain, the workers went on with the project. (每空一词)
items.analysis: in spite of = despite，意为「尽管」，后接名词或名词短语。易错点有三：写成 In despite of（despite 后不加 of）、写成 Although spite of（although 后须接句子）、把 in 误作 on。

items.stem: 判断下列句子是否正确：We are looking forward to hearing from you soon. (√ / ×)
items.analysis: look forward to 中的 to 是介词，后接名词或动名词，hearing 正确。若写成 to hear，就是把 to 误当不定式符号，这是该短语最常见的错误。

items.stem: He is well known ___ a writer, and his works are familiar ___ many young readers.
items.analysis: be known as + 身份，be known for + 特征或作品；be familiar to sb 意为'为某人所熟悉'，be familiar with sth 意为'熟悉某物'。

items.stem: Fill in each blank with a proper preposition: (1) She is accustomed ___ getting up early. (2) The teacher was quite satisfied ___ our performance. (3) ___ average, he spends two hours on his homework every day.
items.analysis: be accustomed to doing、be satisfied with、on average 都是固定搭配，注意 to 在此为介词，后接动名词。

items.stem: Please ______ the lights before you leave the classroom.
items.analysis: turn off 关闭（电器、灯）；turn on 打开；turn up 调高音量或「出现」；turn down 调低或「拒绝」。离开教室应关灯，选 turn off。

items.stem: I'm ______ my glasses. Have you seen them anywhere?
items.analysis: look for 寻找，强调动作；look after 照顾；look at 看；look up 查阅。后句「你见过吗」说明说话人在找东西，故用 look for。

items.stem: Please ___ the light before you leave the room.
items.analysis: turn off 意为'关掉（灯、电器）'；turn on 打开，turn up 调高/出现，turn down 调低/拒绝。

items.stem: Could you ______ my dog for a few days while I'm on business?
items.analysis: look after 照顾、照看，相当于 take care of；出差期间请人照看狗，符合语境。look for 是寻找，look into 是调查，look through 是浏览。

items.stem: Please ______ the rubbish when you go downstairs.
items.analysis: take out 把……带出去（垃圾、物品），take out the rubbish 即「倒垃圾」；take off 脱下或起飞；take away 拿走、夺走；take up 占据或开始从事。

items.stem: I'll ___ you at the school gate at seven.
items.analysis: pick up 意为'（开车）接人、拾起'；pick out 挑选，take up 占据/开始从事，put up 举起/搭建。

items.stem: Please turn ______ the radio; I can't hear it clearly. (每空一词)
items.analysis: turn up 表示「调高（音量）」，与「听不清」对应；turn down 是调低，turn off 是关闭，都与「听不清」矛盾。

items.stem: If you don't know the word, you can ______ it ______ in the dictionary.
items.analysis: look up 表示「在词典、资料中查阅」，代词作宾语时必须放在 look 与 up 之间，即 look it up。look for 是寻找，look into 是调查，look through 是浏览，均不合语境。

items.stem: Don't ______ hope. If you keep trying, you will succeed some day.
items.analysis: give up 放弃，give up hope 是常见搭配；give in 意为「屈服」，是不及物用法，后面不能接 hope；give out 分发或耗尽；give away 赠送或泄露。

items.stem: The sports meeting has been ______ till next Friday because of the heavy rain.
items.analysis: put off 推迟，与 till next Friday 呼应；put on 穿上、上演；put out 扑灭；put up 举起、张贴、搭建。因大雨把运动会推迟，故选 put off。

items.stem: The plane to Beijing will ______ at 9:20 and land at 11:40.
items.analysis: take off 除「脱下」外还表示「（飞机）起飞」，与后面的 land 形成对应；take on 承担或呈现；take over 接管；take in 吸收、理解或欺骗。

items.stem: A fire ______ in the market at midnight, but nobody was hurt.
items.analysis: break out 指战争、火灾、疾病突然爆发，是不及物短语，没有被动形式；break down 出故障或崩溃；break up 打碎、解散；break into 闯入，是及物短语。

items.stem: Whenever you are in trouble, you can ______ me for help.
items.analysis: turn to sb for help 意为「向某人求助」，to 后接人；turn on 打开；turn down 拒绝或调低；turn up 出现或调高。

items.stem: I'll take care ______ your dog while you are away on holiday. (每空一词)
items.analysis: take care of 意为「照顾」，等于 look after；care 后固定接 of，不能省略。注意 take care（保重）单独使用时不带 of，两者不可混淆。

items.stem: The little boy takes ______ his father; they look exactly the same. (每空一词)
items.analysis: take after 意为「（在外貌或性格上）像（长辈）」，后接人；不能与 look after（照顾）或 take care of 混淆。

items.stem: 判断下列句子是否正确：The plane took up at eight o'clock this morning. (√ / ×)
items.analysis: 飞机起飞是 take off，不是 take up；take up 意为占据（时间、空间）或开始从事（爱好）。学生易把 up 与 off 混用，这是短语动词最常见的搭配错误。

items.stem: 将下列句子译成英语：离开教室时请随手关灯。
items.answer: Please turn off the lights when you leave the classroom.
items.analysis: turn off 意为「关闭（灯、电器）」；when 引导时间状语从句，主句是祈使句时，从句用一般现在时表示将来（主将从现的延伸）。学生易误用 turn down 或 turn over。

items.stem: The meeting was ___ because the manager was ill.
items.analysis: put off 意为'推迟'；put on 穿上/上演，put out 扑灭，put away 收好。

items.stem: Choose all the sentences in which the phrasal verb is used correctly.
options: He looks after his sick mother carefully.
She looked up the word in the dictionary.
The fire was put out by the firefighters.
He takes after his father in appearance.
They called on the match because of the rain.
items.analysis: 表示'取消'的是 call off，call on 意为'拜访、号召'，故 E 错；其余各句的短语动词用法均正确。

items.stem: The company ___ a new way to cut costs last year.
items.analysis: come up with 意为'想出（主意、办法）'；come about 发生，come across 偶然遇到，come along 进展/一起来。

items.stem: The small company was ______ by a large group last year, and it now has 300 workers.
items.analysis: take over 接管、收购，与主语 company 构成被动语态；take off 起飞或脱下；take up 占据或从事；take down 记下或拆除。后文说员工增至 300 人，说明公司被大集团收购。

items.stem: I can't ______ the noise from the street any longer. I'll move to another flat.
items.analysis: put up with 意为「忍受」，相当于 tolerate，can't put up with 是「无法忍受」的固定表达；put away 收好；put down 放下或写下；put through 接通电话。

items.stem: Our car broke ______ on the way to the airport, so we missed the flight. (每空一词)
items.analysis: break down 指车辆、机器出故障（也可指人崩溃），与「错过航班」的语境吻合；break out 是爆发，break up 是解散，均不能表示故障。

items.stem: 判断下列句子是否正确：He turned down my invitation because he was too busy. (√ / ×)
items.analysis: turn down 除「调低音量」外，还可表示「拒绝（提议、邀请）」，本句意为婉拒邀请，用法正确。学生若只记「调低」一义，就会误判为错。

items.stem: 将下列句子译成英语：无论遇到多大困难，你都不要放弃。
items.answer: No matter how great the difficulties are, don't give up.
items.analysis: no matter how + 形容词 + 主语 + 系动词 引导让步状语从句，语序不倒装，how 后紧跟形容词；主句用否定祈使句 don't give up。易错点是写成 whatever how 或从句语序错乱。

items.stem: The teacher ___ the students' homework and found many mistakes in it.
items.analysis: look through 意为'浏览、通读'；look into 调查，look up 查阅/抬头看，look after 照顾。

items.stem: Fill in each blank with a proper word to complete the phrasal verb: (1) The plane will take ___ at eight o'clock. (2) Don't give ___ so easily; try again. (3) He broke ___ in the middle of his speech.
items.analysis: take off 起飞，give up 放弃，break down 中断/出故障，三者都是固定短语动词，空格处填副词。

items.stem: Excuse me, could you ______ me the way to the railway station?
items.analysis: tell 可接双宾语（tell sb sth），tell sb the way 意为「给某人指路」；say 后接说话内容（say sth to sb），不能带「人」作间接宾语；speak 多接语言或作不及物动词；talk 须与 with、to、about 搭配。

items.stem: He ______ good morning to me and then hurried away.
items.analysis: say good morning / hello / sorry to sb 是固定表达，say 的宾语是说话内容；tell 后须接人（tell sb sth），不能说 tell good morning to sb；speak 和 talk 不与具体问候语搭配。

items.stem: Could you ___ me the way to the railway station?
items.analysis: tell sb sth 意为'告诉某人某事'；say 后接说话内容，speak 多接语言，talk 常与 to、with、about 连用。

items.stem: I ______ him singing an English song in the next room just now.
items.analysis: hear 强调听到的结果，可构成 hear sb doing sth（听见某人正在做某事）；listen 强调听的动作，须加 to 才能带宾语，且不能表示「无意中听见」；sound 是系动词，主语不能是人。

items.stem: He can ___ three languages fluently.
items.analysis: speak 后接语言名词，表示'说某种语言'，如 speak English；say 强调说话内容，tell 须有间接宾语。

items.stem: He ______ me that he would come back before Friday. (用 say 或 tell 的适当形式填空)
items.analysis: tell sb that... 是 tell 的固定用法，必须带「人」作宾语；say 不能直接接人，须说成 say to sb that...。主句表示过去的动作，用一般过去时 told，从句相应用过去将来时。

items.stem: 将下列句子译成英语：你能告诉我怎么去最近的银行吗？
items.answer: Could you tell me how to get to the nearest bank?
items.analysis: tell sb + 疑问词 + 不定式 构成宾语，故用 tell 而不是 say；「怎么去」译为 how to get to；near 的最高级是 nearest。学生常误写 say me 或 speak me。

items.stem: May I ______ your bike for an hour? Mine has a flat tyre.
items.analysis: borrow 是「借入」，结构为 borrow sth from sb，主语是借的人；lend 是「借出」，结构为 lend sb sth / lend sth to sb。说话人想借对方的车，故用 borrow。keep 表示「保留」，return 表示「归还」，都不合语境。

items.stem: Could you ______ me fifty yuan? I'll pay you back tomorrow.
items.analysis: lend sb sth 表示「把东西借给某人」，句中动作由对方发出（你能借给我钱吗），故用 lend；borrow 只能构成 borrow sth from sb，方向相反。「明天还你」进一步说明是对方借出。

items.stem: It ______ me about half an hour to walk to school every day.
items.analysis: It takes sb some time to do sth 是固定句型，it 为形式主语；spend 的主语必须是人（sb spends time on sth / in doing sth）；cost 的主语是物（sth costs sb money）；pay 的主语是人，且搭配 pay money for sth。

items.stem: I ______ 200 yuan on this dictionary last week.
items.analysis: spend money on sth 的主语是人，与 I 一致，且 last week 要求过去式 spent；cost 的主语是物；take 用于 It takes... 句型；pay 必须与 for 搭配（pay 200 yuan for the dictionary），而本题介词是 on。

items.stem: Please ______ the blackboard carefully, and you will find the answer.
items.analysis: look at 强调有意识地「看」这个动作，适合祈使句；see 强调看见的结果，一般不用祈使句；watch 用于观看比赛、电视等持续过程；look 是不及物动词，必须加 at 才能带宾语。

items.stem: I'm afraid I can't ______ your gift. It's far too expensive.
items.analysis: accept 表示主观上「接受、收下」，receive 只表示客观上「收到」，不含意愿。句中因礼物太贵而婉拒，强调的是主观态度，故用 accept；take 和 get 无此辨析含义。

items.stem: Remember to ______ your dictionary here tomorrow; we'll need it in class.
items.analysis: bring 表示「带来」，方向朝说话人，与 here 一致；take 表示「带走」，方向离开说话人；carry 强调负重搬运，不强调方向；fetch 是「去取来」，含往返过程。

items.stem: The new bike ______ him nearly 1,000 yuan. (用 spend、cost、take 或 pay 的适当形式填空)
items.analysis: sth costs sb money 中主语是物，本句主语 The new bike 是物，故用 cost，其过去式与原形同形；若用 spend，主语须是人；用 take 须以 it 作形式主语；用 pay 须搭配 for。

items.stem: I ______ 300 yuan for the concert ticket yesterday. (用 spend、cost、take 或 pay 的适当形式填空)
items.analysis: pay money for sth 是人作主语的固定搭配，yesterday 要求用过去式 paid；spend 的搭配是 on sth 或 (in) doing，与本题的 for 不符。

items.stem: 判断下列句子是否正确：He borrowed me his bike yesterday. (√ / ×)
items.analysis: borrow 不能带双宾语，正确说法是 He lent me his bike 或 He lent his bike to me；borrow 的结构只能是 borrow sth from sb（借入）。本句同时混淆了 borrow 与 lend 的方向和句型。

items.stem: May I ___ your dictionary for a moment?
items.analysis: borrow 意为'借入'（向别人借），lend 意为'借出'（借给别人）；keep 表示'保存'，与'借'的语境不符。

items.stem: Choose all the sentences in which say, tell, speak or talk is used correctly.
options: He said to me, 'I am busy.'
He said me that he was busy.
He told me that he was busy.
He told that he was busy.
He talked about his plan with us.
items.analysis: say 不能直接接人作宾语，须用 say to sb，故 B 错；tell 后必须接人，tell sb that ...，故 D 错。

items.stem: It ___ me three hours to finish the report yesterday.
items.analysis: It takes sb some time to do sth 是固定句型；spend 的主语须是人，cost 的主语是物，pay 常与 for 连用。

items.stem: The price of vegetables has ______ by about 20 percent this year.
items.analysis: rise 是不及物动词（rise-rose-risen），指价格、数量自行上升，没有宾语，与 has 构成现在完成时；raise 是及物动词，后面必须带宾语；arise 意为「（问题、情况）出现」，arose 是它的过去式。

items.stem: He ______ his hand to ask the teacher a question.
items.analysis: raise 是及物动词，raise one's hand 意为「举手」，后面有宾语 his hand，故只能用 raised；rise 不及物，不能带宾语。学生常因「举起」与「上升」意思相近而误选 rose。

items.stem: I'd like to ______ a few words about the plan at the meeting. (用 say、tell、speak 或 talk 的适当形式填空)
items.analysis: say a few words 是固定表达，意为「说几句话」，say 后接说话内容；speak 通常接语言（speak English）或不带宾语；talk 须搭配 about 或 with；tell 必须有「人」作宾语。

items.stem: 判断下列句子是否正确：I listened carefully but heard nothing. (√ / ×)
items.analysis: listen 强调「听」的动作，可单独使用，带宾语时须加 to；hear 强调「听见」的结果。前半句说认真听（动作），后半句说没听见（结果），两个词各得其所，句子正确。

items.stem: 将下列句子译成英语：他花了两个小时才解决这个问题。
items.answer: It took him two hours to solve the problem.
items.analysis: It takes sb some time to do sth 是固定句型，主语用形式主语 it；不能译成 He spent two hours to solve，因为 spend 后接动名词或 on sth。solve 与 problem 搭配。

items.stem: Great changes have ___ in our village since 2010.
items.analysis: take place 是不及物短语，没有被动语态，故 B 错；occur to sb 意为'某人想到'，happen to 后接人或物，均不合句意。

items.stem: Fill in each blank with one proper word: (1) He ___ me a story about his childhood. (2) The meeting will ___ place in Room 305. (3) Don't ___ so much noise in the classroom.
items.analysis: tell sb a story 讲故事，take place 发生，make noise 制造噪音，都是固定搭配，注意 noise 与 make 搭配而不用 do。

items.stem: Tom is very ______; he often leaves his keys at home.
items.analysis: 系动词 is 后接形容词作表语；由后句「常把钥匙忘在家里」可知是「粗心的」，care + 否定后缀 -less 构成 careless。carefully 是副词不能作表语，care 是名词或动词。

items.stem: The doctor said the old man's illness was ______, but his family never gave up.
items.analysis: -less 是否定后缀，hopeless 意为「没有希望的、无望的」，与 but his family never gave up 的转折逻辑一致；hopeful 意为「抱有希望的」，语义相反；hope 是名词或动词，hopefully 是副词。

items.stem: Your answer is ___ ; please try again.
items.analysis: 系动词 is 后作表语须用形容词；in- 是否定前缀，incorrect 意为'不正确的'。

items.stem: It is ______ to finish so much work in only one hour.
items.analysis: im- 是否定前缀，用于以 m、p、b 开头的形容词，impossible 意为「不可能的」，与「一小时做完这么多工作」的语境一致；possible 语义相反；possibly 和 impossibly 是副词，不能作 is 后的表语。

items.stem: A ______ from Canada will give us a talk on Friday.
items.analysis: 空处是句子主语，指「一名来访者」，由 visit + 表示人的后缀 -or 构成 visitor；冠词 a 后须接单数，故 visitors 不合；visit 是动词或名词，不能指人。

items.stem: He is a famous ___ and has written many novels.
items.analysis: -er 后缀表示'从事……的人'，write 去 e 加 -r 构成 writer，意为'作家'。

items.stem: Thank you for your ______ (kind). I'll never forget your help.
items.analysis: 形容词性物主代词 your 后须接名词，形容词 kind 加后缀 -ness 构成抽象名词 kindness，意为「好意、善意」。

items.stem: It is ______ to drive a car without a driving licence in China.
items.analysis: legal 的否定形式是 illegal，否定前缀 in- 在字母 l 前同化为 il-。inlegal、unlegal、dislegal 都不是英语中存在的词形，属于典型的构词错误。

items.stem: The teacher spoke so ______ that I could hardly follow him.
items.analysis: 修饰动词 spoke 须用副词，quick + -ly 构成 quickly；quick 是形容词，quickness 是名词，quickest 是形容词最高级，都不能修饰动词。

items.stem: Air ______ has become a serious problem in many big cities.
items.analysis: 空处是主语的中心词，须用名词；动词 pollute 加后缀 -ion 构成不可数名词 pollution。polluted 和 polluting 是分词，pollute 是动词，均不能作主语。

items.stem: His ______ has changed the way people communicate with each other.
items.analysis: 物主代词 his 后接名词；invent + -ion 构成名词 invention（发明物），与 has changed the way people communicate（改变了人们的交流方式）呼应；inventor 指「发明者」，是人，与谓语内容不符；inventive 是形容词。

items.stem: We were ______ at the news that our team had lost the match.
items.analysis: 主语 we 是人，表示「感到失望的」，用 -ed 形容词；disappointing 修饰引起失望的事物（如 The result is disappointing）；disappoint 是动词，disappointment 是名词。

items.stem: There is little ______ between the two answers.
items.analysis: there be 句型中缺少主语中心词，须用名词；differ + 后缀 -ence 构成 difference，little 修饰不可数名词 difference；different 是形容词，differ 是动词，differently 是副词。

items.stem: It will ______ rain this evening, so take an umbrella with you.
items.analysis: 修饰谓语 will rain 须用副词，probable + -ly 构成 probably；probable 和 improbable 是形容词，probability 是名词，都不能修饰动词。

items.stem: The ______ (science) has spent ten years studying the new virus.
items.analysis: 空处是句子主语且指人，science 加表示人的后缀 -ist 构成 scientist（科学家）；冠词 the 与谓语 has 说明该名词是单数。

items.stem: 判断下列句子是否正确：He wants to be a famous music when he grows up. (√ / ×)
items.analysis: music 是不可数名词，不能指人，也不能用 a 修饰；表示「音乐家」须用 music + 表示人的后缀 -ian 构成的 musician。这是把不可数名词误当作表人名词的典型错误。

items.stem: 将下列句子译成英语：这个好消息使我们非常兴奋。
items.answer: The good news made us very excited.
items.analysis: make sb + 形容词 构成宾语补足语；excite 的 -ed 形容词 excited 表示「人感到兴奋的」，与 us 对应，-ing 形式 exciting 表示「令人兴奋的」；news 不可数，谓语用单数。

items.stem: The ___ of the machine is quite simple.
items.analysis: 定冠词 the 后作主语须用名词，operate 的名词形式是 operation（-tion 后缀）。

items.stem: Choose all the words that are correctly formed with a negative prefix.
items.analysis: 以 p 开头的形容词前用 im-，故应为 impossible，inpossible 是错误形式；其余三个否定前缀 in-、un-、il- 使用正确。

items.stem: The teacher explained the rule ___ so that everyone could understand it.
items.analysis: 修饰动词 explained 须用副词，形容词 clear 加 -ly 构成 clearly。

items.stem: The government has taken ______ to protect wild animals in this area.
items.analysis: take action 是固定搭配，意为「采取行动」，action 是名词；active 是形容词，actively 是副词；act 作名词时多指「行为、法案」，不构成 take act 这一搭配。

items.stem: This dictionary is ______ to beginners because it has no Chinese explanations.
items.analysis: use + 否定后缀 -less 构成 useless，意为「无用的」；because 从句说明「没有中文解释」，对初学者没有帮助，故须用否定意义；useful 语义相反，used 和 using 是分词。

items.stem: ______ (fortune), he missed the last bus and had to walk home.
items.analysis: 空处在句首修饰整个句子，须用副词；fortune 加否定前缀 un-、后缀 -ate 再加 -ly 构成 unfortunately，意为「不幸的是」，与「错过末班车、只能走回家」的语境一致，句首字母须大写。

items.stem: 判断下列句子是否正确：In the word unhappy, the prefix un- means again. (√ / ×)
items.analysis: un- 是表示否定的前缀（unhappy 不快乐的、unfair 不公平的）；表示「再、又」的前缀是 re-（rewrite 重写、return 返回）。混淆 un- 与 re- 的含义是构词法常见错误。

items.stem: 将下列句子译成英语：为了保护环境，我们应该减少污染。
items.answer: To protect the environment, we should reduce pollution.
items.analysis: 目的状语用不定式 To protect...；environment 前加定冠词 the 表示特指；pollution 由 pollute + -ion 构成，是不可数名词，不加冠词 a，也没有复数形式。

items.stem: His behaviour was so ___ that everyone present felt ___ of him.
items.analysis: shameful 意为'可耻的'，修饰行为；ashamed 意为'感到羞愧的'，用于 be/feel ashamed of，修饰人的感受。

items.stem: Write the correct form of the word in brackets: (1) The ___ (invent) of the telephone changed our life. (2) He looked at me ___ (angry). (3) It is ___ (use) to argue with him; he never listens.
items.analysis: the 后作主语用名词 invention；修饰动词 looked 用副词 angrily；It is useless to do sth 中 -less 构成否定形容词。

items.stem: The film ___ nearly three hours, so we got home very late.
items.analysis: last 作动词意为'持续'，主语是时间或活动；spend 的主语须是人，take 常用于 it takes ... 句型。

items.stem: Would you ___ my opening the window? It is a bit hot in here.
items.analysis: mind 意为“介意”，后接动名词，Would you mind doing...? 是请求对方做事的固定句式。like、want、hope 后接动名词时意为“喜欢、想要、希望开窗”，与请求语气不符；若表示请求，like 后须用 to do。

items.stem: Please ___ me a few minutes; I have something important to tell you.
items.analysis: spare sb some time 意为'给某人抽出一点时间'；save 表示'节省、拯救'，spend 表示'花费'，share 表示'分享'，均不合语境。

items.stem: This kind of work ___ (call) for patience and carefulness.
items.analysis: call for 意为“需要”。主语 this kind of work 是第三人称单数，句子陈述一般情况，用一般现在时，故填 calls；学生常忽略主谓一致而误填 call。

items.stem: 在 He booked two tickets online. 一句中，book 用作动词，意为“预订”。
items.analysis: book 最常见的是名词“书”，但也可作动词表示“预订（房间、餐位、票）”，book tickets 即“订票”，判断正确。

items.stem: You'd better ___ a table for six before Friday, or the restaurant may be full.
items.analysis: book 常用作名词“书”，此处用作动词，意为“预订”。borrow 是“借入”，bring 是“带来”，build 是“建造”，都不能与 a table 搭配表示订餐位。

items.stem: His family ___ a small noodle shop near the school, and it is always busy at noon.
items.analysis: run 除“跑”外还可表示“经营、管理”，run a shop 即“经营一家店铺”。make、do、take 与 shop 搭配都不能表示经营。

items.stem: The manager asked us to ___ the problem before the meeting ended.
items.analysis: address 常用作名词“地址”，作动词时意为“处理、应对（问题）”，address the problem 即“解决问题”。speak 和 talk 是不及物动词，不能直接带 problem 作宾语；say 后面须接说话的内容。

items.stem: Ten dollars will ___ the cost of the meal, so you needn't pay anything extra.
items.analysis: cover 此处意为“足够支付、够付”，cover the cost 是常见搭配。spend 的主语必须是人；cost 表示“花费”时主语是物，宾语是钱而不是 cost 本身；pay 须说 pay for the meal。

items.stem: The judge is known for being ___ to everyone, rich or poor.
items.analysis: just 除“仅仅”外，作形容词时意为“公正的”，be just to sb 意为“对某人公正”。only、merely、simply 都是副词，不能作表语，也不表示“公正”。

items.stem: The driver was ___ 200 yuan for parking in a no-parking area.
items.analysis: fine 作动词意为“处以罚款”，be fined + 钱数 + for doing sth 是固定结构。punish 用 punish sb with/by；warn 用 warn sb of/about；scold 用 scold sb for，且三者都不能直接跟钱数表示罚款。

items.stem: The students ___ more than 5,000 yuan for the children in the mountain areas last term.
items.analysis: raise 是及物动词，raise money 意为“筹钱”。rise（过去式 rose）是不及物动词“上升”，不能带宾语；arise 意为“出现、产生”；lift 是“举起”，与钱搭配不当。

items.stem: Please write your name in ___ letters at the top of the page.
items.analysis: capital 除“首都、资本”外，还可作形容词表示“大写的”，capital letters 即“大写字母”。chief、main、major 都表示“主要的”，不能修饰 letters 表示大写。

items.stem: The meeting ___ (last) nearly three hours yesterday, so we missed the last bus.
items.analysis: last 此处是动词“持续”，为不及物动词；yesterday 表明用一般过去时，故填 lasted。last 无被动形式，不能填 was lasted。

items.stem: Mr. Li ___ (head) the research team since 2019.
items.analysis: head 作动词意为“领导、负责”，是熟词僻义；since 2019 要求用现在完成时，主语为第三人称单数，故填 has headed。

items.stem: 在 The film lasted two hours. 一句中，last 是及物动词，two hours 作它的宾语。
items.analysis: last 表示“持续”时是不及物动词，two hours 是时间状语而不是宾语，该句也不能变成被动语态，故判断错误。

items.stem: 将下列句子译成汉语：The firm has covered a wide range of business since it was set up in 2005.
items.answer: 这家公司自 2005 年成立以来，业务范围已覆盖多个领域。
items.analysis: cover 此处意为“涵盖、包括”；firm 意为“公司”；since 引导时间状语时主句用现在完成时，译作“自……以来”。

items.stem: The government has decided to ___ the problem of air pollution.
items.analysis: address 除'演讲'外还可作及物动词表示'处理、应对（问题）'，相当于 deal with，是本题的熟词僻义。

items.stem: Choose all the statements about word meaning that are correct.
options: In 'The meeting lasted two hours', 'last' means 'continue'.
In 'He booked a room', 'book' means 'to reserve'.
In 'She is a green hand', 'green' means 'the colour of grass'.
In 'He addressed the meeting', 'address' means 'to make a speech to'.
In 'The soup tastes good', 'taste' is a linking verb meaning 'to have a certain flavour'.
items.analysis: a green hand 意为'新手、生手'，green 在此不表示颜色，故 C 错；其余各项均为常见多义或熟词僻义用法。

items.stem: The new policy will come ___ effect next month.
items.analysis: come into effect 意为'生效'，是固定短语，其中 into 不可换成其他介词。

items.stem: Every driver must ___ the traffic rules, even on an empty road.
items.analysis: observe 的熟词僻义是“遵守（法律、规则、习俗）”，observe the rules 即“遵守规则”。watch 是“观看（活动）”，notice 是“注意到”，look 是不及物动词，三者都不能表示遵守。

items.stem: The hotel ___ us 300 yuan a night for a room with a sea view.
items.analysis: charge sb + 钱数 + for sth 意为“向某人收取费用”。cost 的主语是物或服务；spend 的主语是人，且用 spend money on sth；pay 表示“支付”，方向相反，不能表示“向某人收费”。

items.stem: All the prices are ___ to change without notice, so ask before you order.
items.analysis: be subject to 意为“可能受……影响、取决于”，是固定搭配，句中表示价格可能变动。equal to 是“等于”，close to 是“接近”，ready to 是“准备好做”，都不合语境。

items.stem: The ___ (cover) of the sports meeting was given by the local TV station.
items.analysis: cover 的派生名词 coverage 意为“报道”，在句中作主语。cover 作名词时意为“盖子、封面”，与句意不符，故不能填 cover。

items.stem: 将下列句子译成英语：会上，经理要求我们尽快处理这个问题。
items.answer: At the meeting, the manager asked us to address the problem as soon as possible.
items.analysis: “处理问题”用 address the problem，不能用 deal the problem；“尽快”译作 as soon as possible；主句用一般过去时 asked，to address 作宾语补足语。

items.stem: 'The evidence is thin.' In this sentence 'thin' most probably means ___.
items.analysis: thin 修饰 evidence（证据）时意为'缺乏说服力的'，属熟词僻义；not thick、not fat、not dense 均为其本义。

items.stem: Complete the sentences with the proper form of the words in the box: last / address / run. (1) The concert ___ about two hours. (2) The mayor ___ the crowd at the opening ceremony. (3) He ___ a small company that sells computers.
items.analysis: last 表示'持续'，用过去式 lasted；address 表示'向……讲话'，用过去式 addressed；run 表示'经营'，主语 he 为第三人称单数用 runs。

items.stem: He is good ___ playing basketball.
items.analysis: be good at doing sth 意为'擅长做某事'；be good for 意为'对……有益'，注意区分。

items.stem: Mr. Wang is ___ charge of the sales department of our company.
items.analysis: in charge of 是固定短语，意为“负责、主管”。charge 与其余三个介词搭配都不能表示“负责”，学生常误用 on charge of。

items.stem: We should take advantage ___ this opportunity.
items.analysis: take advantage of 是固定搭配，意为'利用（机会等）'。

items.stem: The old man is very proud ___ his grandson's success in the competition.
items.analysis: be proud of 意为“为……感到骄傲”，是固定搭配；proud 后不能用 for 或 to。

items.stem: take care of 与 look after 意思相近，都可以表示“照顾”。
items.analysis: take care of 与 look after 都是“照顾、照料”的常用短语，意义上基本相通，判断正确。

items.stem: The neighbours play loud music every night, and I really can't ______ it any longer.
items.analysis: put up with 意为“忍受”，与 can't ... any longer 搭配表示“再也受不了”。put off 是“推迟”，put on 是“穿上、上演”，put out 是“扑灭”，都不能接 it 表示忍受噪音。

items.stem: We should take full ___ of the chance to practise our English with foreign teachers.
items.analysis: take advantage of 是固定搭配，意为“利用”。use 的搭配是 make use of；benefit 用 benefit from；interest 用 take an interest in。学生常按汉语“利用”直译成 take use of，属典型错误。

items.stem: The nurse ___ good care of the old man during his stay in hospital.
items.analysis: take care of 意为“照顾”，此处用过去式 took。make、do 不能与 care 构成该短语；pay 的固定搭配是 pay attention to。

items.stem: The students are busy ___ for the final examination these days.
items.analysis: be busy doing sth 意为“忙于做某事”，busy 后接动名词。学生常受 be busy with sth 影响误填 to prepare 或动词原形。

items.stem: The young man was ___ of stealing a bike and was taken to the police station.
items.analysis: accuse sb of sth 意为“指控某人做了某事”。charge 的搭配是 charge sb with sth；blame 用 blame sb for sth；scold 用 scold sb for sth，三个介词的搭配各不相同。

items.stem: Nothing could prevent the little boy ___ running to his mother.
items.analysis: prevent sb from doing sth 意为“阻止某人做某事”，from 在主动式中可省略，但不能换成其他介词。学生常受 stop sb to do 的错记影响误选 to。

items.stem: The area is rich ___ coal and other natural resources.
items.analysis: be rich in 意为“富含”，是固定搭配。with 用于 be filled with、be covered with；of 用于 be full of，不能与 rich 搭配。

items.stem: She burst ___ tears when she heard that she had passed the exam.
items.analysis: burst into tears 意为“突然大哭”，是固定搭配。burst out 后面接动名词（burst out crying）；burst with 表示“充满（某种情感）”；burst in 是“闯入”。

items.stem: We all congratulated him ___ passing the driving test.
items.analysis: congratulate sb on sth 意为“祝贺某人某事”，介词只能用 on；学生常受“为……祝贺”影响误填 for。

items.stem: The small hospital is in great need ___ experienced nurses.
items.analysis: in need of 意为“需要”，是固定搭配，need 在此作名词；介词不能用 for 或 to。

items.stem: be used to do sth 表示“习惯于做某事”。
items.analysis: be used to doing sth 才表示“习惯于做某事”，其中 to 是介词；be used to do sth 表示“被用来做某事”，是不定式表目的；used to do 则表示“过去常常”。

items.stem: 将下列句子译成英语：我们应该充分利用这次机会提高英语水平。
items.answer: We should take full advantage of this opportunity to improve our English.
items.analysis: “充分利用”用 take full advantage of，不能译成 take full use of；“机会”用 opportunity；to improve 作目的状语。

items.stem: The doctor advised him to give ___ smoking.
items.analysis: give up 意为'放弃'，后接动名词 smoking；give in 屈服，give off 发出（气味等），give away 赠送/泄露。

items.stem: Choose all the correct collocations.
items.analysis: 表示'犯错误'用 make a mistake，不用 do，故 B 错；其余均为正确的动名搭配。

items.stem: The manager is ___ charge of the department.
items.analysis: in charge of 意为'负责、掌管'；in the charge of sb 才表示'由某人负责'，两者主语不同。

items.stem: Our teacher ___ great importance to reading aloud every morning.
items.analysis: attach importance to 意为“重视”，是固定搭配。pay 的搭配是 pay attention to；take 用 take notice of 或 take pride in；put 用 put emphasis on。

items.stem: He was on the ___ of giving up when his teacher came to help him.
items.analysis: on the point of doing sth 意为“正要、即将做某事”，是固定搭配。edge 用 on the edge of 表示“在……边缘”；time 用 at the time of；moment 用 at the moment of。

items.stem: ___ spite of the heavy rain, the football match went on as planned.
items.analysis: in spite of 意为“尽管”，是固定短语，相当于 despite。spite 前只能用 in，且该短语后接名词，不能接句子，也不能与 although 连用。

items.stem: The manager insisted ___ checking every figure himself.
items.analysis: insist on doing sth 意为“坚持做某事”，介词用 on。若 insist 后接 that 从句则表示“坚持主张”，结构不同。

items.stem: 将下列句子译成汉语：Nothing can prevent him from carrying out the plan to which he has attached so much importance.
items.answer: 没有什么能够阻止他实施那个他如此重视的计划。
items.analysis: prevent sb from doing sth 译为“阻止某人做某事”；carry out 意为“实施、执行”；to which 引导定语从句，先行词 the plan 是 attach importance to 的宾语。

items.stem: He has a good command ___ English and is well qualified ___ the job.
items.analysis: have a good command of 意为'精通（语言）'，be qualified for 意为'胜任'，均为固定介词搭配。

items.stem: Fill in each blank with a proper preposition: (1) We are looking forward ___ hearing from you. (2) He is addicted ___ computer games. (3) She insisted ___ paying the bill herself.
items.analysis: look forward to doing、be addicted to、insist on doing 均为固定搭配，其中 to 是介词，后接动名词。

items.stem: The climate here has a great ___ on people's health.
items.analysis: have an effect on 意为'对……有影响'，effect 是名词；affect 是动词，不能用在冠词 a 之后。

items.stem: Could you ___ me your dictionary for a moment? Mine is at home.
items.analysis: lend 是“借出”，结构为 lend sb sth，把某物借给某人；borrow 是“借入”，结构为 borrow sth from sb。说话人向对方借，对方是借出方，故用 lend。

items.stem: The sun ___ in the east and sets in the west.
items.analysis: rise 是不及物动词“升起”，没有被动语态，表示客观真理用一般现在时，主语 the sun 为第三人称单数，故用 rises。raise 是及物动词“举起、提高”，后面必须带宾语。

items.stem: Please keep ___ while the baby is sleeping in the next room.
items.analysis: keep quiet 意为“保持安静”，quiet 是形容词作表语。quite 是副词“相当”，quit 是动词“放弃、离开”，quilt 是名词“被子”，四词仅拼写相近。

items.stem: They decided to ___ the new teaching method.
items.analysis: adopt 意为'采用、采纳'；adapt 意为'适应、改编'，adept 是形容词'熟练的'，词性不合。

items.stem: The doctor gave me some useful ___ (advise) on how to keep fit.
items.analysis: advice 是不可数名词，没有复数形式；advise 是动词。some 后可接不可数名词 advice，故填 advice，不能填 advices 或 advise。

items.stem: advice 是不可数名词，advise 是动词，二者不能混用。
items.analysis: advice 是名词，不能加 s，也不能用 a/an 修饰；advise 是动词，常用于 advise sb to do sth。二者词性与用法都不同，判断正确。

items.stem: Everyone ___ Tom went to the concert, for he was ill that evening.
items.analysis: except 表示“除……之外（不包括）”，与后文“他病了”一致。besides 表示“除……之外还有（包括）”，与句意矛盾；expect 和 accept 是动词，不能作介词。

items.stem: It was very ___ of you to remember my birthday and send me a card.
items.analysis: considerate 意为“体贴的、周到的”，常用 It is considerate of sb to do sth。considerable 意为“相当大的”，多修饰数量或程度，不形容人的行为。

items.stem: The ___ reason for his failure is that he never reviewed his lessons.
items.analysis: principal 作形容词意为“主要的”，修饰 reason。principle 是名词“原则、原理”，拼写相近但词性与意义都不同；principally 是副词，不能修饰名词。

items.stem: The police made a ___ search of the building but found nothing unusual.
items.analysis: thorough 是形容词“彻底的”，修饰 search。through 是介词“穿过”，though 是连词“虽然”，throughout 是介词“遍及”，三者都不能作定语修饰名词。

items.stem: The noise outside had a bad ___ (affect) on my sleep last night.
items.analysis: have an effect on 意为“对……有影响”，effect 是名词；affect 是动词，不能用在冠词 a 之后。a bad effect 即“不良影响”。

items.stem: After a long discussion, the committee ___ (adopt) the new plan.
items.analysis: adopt 意为“采纳”，此处表示过去发生的动作，用过去式 adopted。注意与 adapt（适应）区分，两词拼写只差一个字母，含义完全不同。

items.stem: beside 和 besides 意思相同，在句中可以直接互换。
items.analysis: beside 是介词“在……旁边”，besides 是“除……之外还有”，也可作副词“此外”。二者意义不同，不能互换，这是拼写形近导致的常见错误。

items.stem: 将下列句子译成汉语：The new rule will affect the way students choose their courses, and its effect may last for years.
items.answer: 新规定将影响学生选课的方式，其影响可能会持续多年。
items.analysis: affect 是动词“影响”，effect 是名词“影响”，翻译时都译为“影响”但词性不同；the way 后接定语从句时省略了 in which；last 此处作动词“持续”。

items.stem: He ___ himself to the new environment quickly.
items.analysis: adapt oneself to 意为'使自己适应'；adopt 意为'收养、采纳'，不接反身代词。

items.stem: Choose all the sentences in which the easily confused words are used correctly.
options: The bad weather affected our plan.
The medicine had no effect on him.
He adapted himself to the new life there.
They adopted a child last year.
The film had a great affect on me.
items.analysis: affect 是动词，effect 是名词；E 中 affect 前有冠词 a、后有介词 on，须用名词 effect。

items.stem: Please ___ me to post the letter tomorrow morning.
items.analysis: remind sb to do sth 意为'提醒某人做某事'；remember 后接动名词或 that 从句，不能说 remember sb to do。

items.stem: The heavy rain seriously ___ the traffic in the city last night.
items.analysis: affect 是动词，意为“影响”。effect 通常作名词“影响、效果”，作动词时意为“实现、使发生”，不表示影响；afford 是“负担得起”，offer 是“提供”。

items.stem: It took him a few weeks to ___ himself to the life in the new school.
items.analysis: adapt oneself to 意为“使自己适应”。adopt 是“采纳、收养”，与 adapt 只差一个字母，是本题最主要的干扰项；admit 是“承认”，accept 是“接受”。

items.stem: When I came into the room, the dictionary ___ open on the desk.
items.analysis: lie（躺、位于）的过去式是 lay，过去分词是 lain；lay（放置）的过去式和过去分词都是 laid；lie（说谎）的过去式和过去分词都是 lied。句中表示“摊放在桌上”的状态，用 lie 的过去式 lay。

items.stem: She is very ___ to criticism, so be careful with your words.
items.analysis: be sensitive to 意为“对……敏感”。sensible 是“明智的、通情达理的”；sensational 是“轰动的”；senseless 是“无意义的、失去知觉的”，四个词形近而义远。

items.stem: Buying a season ticket is much more ___ than paying for each journey.
items.analysis: economical 意为“节约的、划算的”，常作表语。economic 意为“经济的”，多作定语修饰 growth、policy 等；economy 是名词“经济、节约”；economics 是“经济学”。

items.stem: He is a highly ___ (imagine) writer, whose stories always surprise his readers.
items.analysis: imaginative 意为“富于想象力的”，修饰人；imaginary 意为“虚构的、想象中的”；imaginable 意为“可想象的”。此处形容作家的才能，用 imaginative。

items.stem: 将下列句子译成英语：除了英语，她还自学了法语，这使她在求职时更有优势。
items.answer: Besides English, she has taught herself French, which gives her an advantage in job hunting.
items.analysis: “除了……还有”用 besides，不能用 except；“自学”译作 teach oneself；which 引导非限制性定语从句指代前面整件事；“有优势”用 have an advantage in。

items.stem: Our ___ reason for choosing this school is that its teaching ___ are excellent.
items.analysis: principal 作形容词意为'主要的'，作名词指'校长'；principle 是名词，意为'原则、准则'，二者同音易混。

items.stem: Write the correct form of the word in brackets: (1) The noise outside ___ (affect) my study, so I closed the window. (2) We should ___ (adapt / adopt) a more flexible policy. (3) Her ___ (advise) was very helpful.
items.analysis: 句子为过去时，affect 用 affected；adopt a policy 意为'采取政策'；advise 的名词形式是 advice。

items.stem: There are ___ students in our school.
items.analysis: hundred、thousand、million 前有具体数字时不加 -s，也不接 of，故为 two thousand students。

items.stem: The film lasted one and a ___ hours, so we got home very late.
items.analysis: one and a half hours 意为“一个半小时”，half 用单数，后面名词用复数。halves 是 half 的复数，用于 two halves 等；halfs 是错误拼写；halve 是动词“平分”。

items.stem: ___ of the students in our class are girls.
items.analysis: 分数由基数词作分子、序数词作分母构成，分子大于 1 时分母加 -s，故为 two thirds。

items.stem: ___ (hundred) of birds fly to the south when winter comes.
items.analysis: 表示不确定的多数用 hundreds of + 复数名词，hundred 要用复数并加 of；若有具体数字则用单数，如 two hundred birds。

items.stem: two hundred students 中 hundred 用单数且后面不加 of；hundreds of students 中 hundred 用复数并加 of。
items.analysis: 有具体数字修饰时用单数且不加 of；表示不确定多数时用复数加 of。两种结构不能混用，判断正确。

items.stem: There are about two ___ students in our school, and most of them live on campus.
items.analysis: 数词 two 后接 hundred、thousand、million 等时用单数形式，且不加 of，即 two thousand students。thousands of 表示“成千上万的”，前面不能有具体数字。

items.stem: ___ people came to the square to watch the fireworks on New Year's Eve.
items.analysis: 表示不确定的多数时用 thousands of + 复数名词。thousand of 缺少复数形式，Thousands people 缺少 of，Thousand people 表示确定数字，均不合句意。

items.stem: About two ___ of the students in our class are girls.
items.analysis: 分数中分子用基数词、分母用序数词，分子大于 1 时分母要加 s，故“三分之二”是 two thirds。分子为 1 时才用 one third。

items.stem: Our classroom is on the ___ floor of that teaching building.
items.analysis: 第十二的序数词是 twelfth，由 twelve 去 ve 加 f 再加 th 构成。twelveth 是常见拼写错误，twelve 是基数词，不能修饰 floor。

items.stem: The sports meeting will be held ___ the morning of October 1st.
items.analysis: 泛指早晨用 in the morning，但被具体日期修饰时用 on，即 on the morning of October 1st。at 用于具体时刻，for 表示持续时间。

items.stem: It's a quarter ___ seven, so we still have fifteen minutes before the class begins at seven.
items.analysis: a quarter to seven 意为“六点四十五”，即差一刻七点，与“还有十五分钟上课”一致。a quarter past seven 是七点一刻，与语境矛盾。

items.stem: He is in his ___ now, but he still plays football every weekend.
items.analysis: in one's thirties 意为“三十多岁”，用数词的复数形式表示年龄段。thirty 是基数词，不能表示年龄阶段；thirtieth 是序数词“第三十”。

items.stem: The school will celebrate its ___ anniversary next October.
items.analysis: 表示“第七十”用序数词 seventieth；句中已有物主代词 its，不能再加 the。seventy 是基数词，seventies 表示“七十年代”或“七十多岁”。

items.stem: He was born on the ___ (twenty) of June, 1998.
items.analysis: 日期中的“日”用序数词，twenty 变为 twentieth（把 y 变 ie 再加 th）；前面已有 the，故不再加冠词。

items.stem: The film began at half ___ seven, so we were ten minutes late.
items.analysis: half past seven 意为“七点半”，是英语中表达半点钟的固定说法；半点之前用 past，半点之后才用 to。

items.stem: three fourths 和 three fourth 都可以表示“四分之三”。
items.analysis: 分数中分子大于 1 时分母必须用复数，故只能说 three fourths 或 three quarters，three fourth 是错误形式。

items.stem: 将下列句子译成英语：我们班三分之一的学生来自农村。
items.answer: One third of the students in our class come from the countryside.
items.analysis: “三分之一”是 one third，分子为 1 时分母用单数；one third of + 复数名词作主语时谓语用复数 come；in our class 作后置定语。

items.stem: He was born ___.
items.analysis: 表示'某个年代'用 in the + 年份复数，即 in the 1990s，意为'20 世纪 90 年代'。

items.stem: Choose all the correct expressions.
items.analysis: 复合形容词中的名词用单数，故 A 对 B 错；hundred 前有具体数字时不接 of，D 应改为 two hundred students。

items.stem: It is about ___ walk from here to the park.
items.analysis: 表示时间长度用名词所有格；ten minutes 以 s 结尾，所有格只在词尾加 '，即 ten minutes' walk。

items.stem: He earns twice ___ much as his brother, though he works fewer hours.
items.analysis: 倍数表达用 twice as much as，第一个 as 不能省略，也不能换成 so；than 只用于比较级结构，此处 much 前没有比较级。

items.stem: The new hall is three times ___ size of the old one.
items.analysis: “倍数 + the size/length/height of”是固定结构，冠词用 the。若用 three times as...as 结构，后面须接形容词，不能直接接 size 这样的名词。

items.stem: He is a ___ boy, but he can already read many English story books.
items.analysis: 数词与名词、形容词构成合成形容词作定语时要用连字符，且名词用单数，即 a ten-year-old boy。ten years old 只能作表语，如 He is ten years old。

items.stem: More than three ___ (quarter) of the earth's surface is covered with water.
items.analysis: 分数“四分之三”是 three quarters，分子大于 1，分母 quarter 要加 s。该分数修饰不可数名词 surface，谓语用单数 is。

items.stem: 将下列句子译成汉语：Last year the museum received two and a half million visitors, three times as many as in 2019.
items.answer: 去年这家博物馆接待了 250 万名参观者，是 2019 年的三倍。
items.analysis: two and a half million 意为“两百五十万”；three times as many as 是倍数表达，译为“是……的三倍”；as many as 指代前文的 visitors。

items.stem: ___ of the students in our grade took part in the contest, and ___ them came from Class Three.
items.analysis: 具体数字后 hundred 不加 -s；分数 two fifths 因分子大于 1 分母用复数，后接 of 表示'其中的'。

items.stem: Fill in the blanks with the correct form: (1) He is in his ___ (thirty) but still single. (2) About three ___ (five) of the students passed the exam. (3) There are ___ (hundred) of people in the square.
items.analysis: in one's thirties 意为'三十多岁时'，用序数词复数；three fifths 分子大于 1 分母加 -s；hundreds of 表示'数百'，用复数并接 of。
